description.value: A randomized double-blind crossover fMRI study examining whether intranasal oxytocin modulates hypothalamic BOLD responses to visual food cues in healthy volunteers.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to use functional neuroimaging to investigate whether oxytocin modulates the neural response to visual food cues in brain regions involved in the control of food intake.

description.value: Double-blind, randomized crossover four-period design with two placebo and two oxytocin treatment periods; participants attended four visits, with fMRI scanning on two visits.
